north_star.description: Maintain a concise standalone skill that preserves outcomes and proven capability fitness across evolution.

fitness_dimensions.description: Proportionate time, tokens, tools, and proof cost.
Authority, evidence integrity, bounded effects, and recovery.

delivery_stages.description: Verify and publish the generic schema-v4 capability-floor contract.

outcome_capabilities.description: Preserve parented outcomes, accepted behavior, and honest evidence.
Keep execution, proof, and communication proportionate and productive.
Remain generic, backward-readable, valid, tested, and idempotently installable.

capability_floors.invariant: Later stages preserve every declared permanent behavior and reject completion without whole-system evidence.
Ordinary changes use cheap deterministic gates while stronger proof is reserved for installation and release boundaries.
The exact generic source remains valid, backward-readable, isolated, and equal to the installed copy.

identity_requirements.description: The standalone skill repository and active installed outcome-integrity skill.

requirements.description: Cheap deterministic tests enforce the generic capability-floor contract after relevant changes.
requirements.proof_scope: Source assertions and adversarial fixtures cover inheritance, fitness, proof cost, state independence, and whole-system gates.
requirements.proof_limits: Deterministic tests do not prove independent model transfer or active installation.

acceptance_steps.description: Reject stages that omit permanent inherited capabilities.
Reject unbalanced fitness or safety-only completion.
Require distinct cheap, pre-release, and whole-system proof tiers.
Require independence proof when optional supporting state exists.

evidence.summary: Thirty-six deterministic tests pass, including seven adversarial capability-preservation cases; skill size decreased to 3,120 words.

requirements.description: Independent generic scenarios apply permanent floors and proportional verification without leaking the motivating diagnosis.
requirements.proof_scope: Fresh agents receive only the updated skill and generic raw project situations.
requirements.proof_limits: Two scenarios do not guarantee every future model or domain.

acceptance_steps.description: Preserve prior useful behavior as an inherited executable floor.
Choose cheap change gates and reserve full benchmarks for release.
Require clean-state behavior when optional learned state exists.

evidence.summary: Fresh agents given only the updated skill and generic raw scenarios preserved old useful behavior as a permanent floor, required clean-state independence, selected cheap deterministic change gates and bounded higher tiers, and withheld release for missing whole-system balanced-fitness evidence.

requirements.description: The exact generic source passes full local validation and installation parity.
requirements.proof_scope: Full tests, official validation, compilation, completion gate, isolated and active installation, exact hashes, and generic-source scan.
requirements.proof_limits: Local release proof does not publish GitHub or guarantee every future response.

acceptance_steps.description: Pass all source, schema, compilation, and official validation gates.
Install idempotently in isolation and the active Codex home.
Match installed source exactly with one managed global rule block.
Contain no project- or provider-specific correction.

evidence.ref: 36 deterministic tests; quick_validate.py; compileall; project validate/resume; isolated and active double-install; exact five-file SHA-256 parity; one managed global block; generic-source scan
evidence.summary: The exact generic schema-v4 source passed every local gate, installed idempotently, matched all five active installed files exactly, retained one managed global block, and contained no motivating project/provider identity.

requirements.description: The exact verified schema-v4 source is merged to the authoritative default branch and published as GitHub release v4.0.0.
requirements.proof_scope: Authoritative remote branch, merged commit, immutable tag, and published non-prerelease GitHub release.
requirements.proof_limits: Publication does not guarantee every future probabilistic response.

acceptance_steps.description: Merge the exact verified source to the authoritative default branch.
Create v4.0.0 at the merged source commit.
Publish a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub release with accurate notes.

evidence.summary: Pull request #5 merged after two passing GitHub Actions runs; authoritative main and tag v4.0.0 resolve to the same merge commit; the public release is non-draft and non-prerelease.
